founded_year.notes: The company’s own 2025 announcement describes interface.ai as founded in 2015. Its timeline distinguishes the 2015–2018 Payjo foundational R&D period from interface.ai being “born” in 2019 as a rebrand and U.S. launch, so 2019 is the brand-launch date rather than the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index describes its content as practical AI and banking trends for credit-union and community-bank leaders, and the visible posts are industry, product, customer, and marketing topics rather than engineering accounts of how the product is built. This supports a negative under the stated blog-index rule.

public_docs.notes: The company homepage/footer points to a Trust Center but shows no public product-docs, help-center, or developer-portal link; the Trust Center says security documentation must be requested. The public knowledge-center material found is marketing resources rather than product documentation.
